Definition: from G5259 and G1210; to bind under one's feet, i.e. put on shoes or sandals:--bind on, (be) shod.
BiblicalUsage: The word hypodéō carries the sense of to bind on, to be shod. In Mark 6:9, the text says "But [be] shod with sandals."
TheologicalSignificance: This one, hypodéō, I take at face value: to bind on, to be shod.
RelatedEvents: Jesus Sends Out the Twelve; Peter's Escape from Prison
